name: Winch
description: Stamps _meta.winch onto tool calls, receives claim webhooks, and wakes agents from the winch event stream.

webhookBearer.description: Shared secret winch must send as Authorization: Bearer on POST /api/winch/claimed. Route stays disarmed (503) until set.

webhookPublicBaseUrl.description: Gateway address winch can reach, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18789. Used by self-registration to build the route URL.

webhookHarness.description: Harness name registered in winch (must match WINCH_HARNESS). Default: openclaw.

webhookAutoregister.description: Register the route URL in winch on boot. Default true when webhookBearer is set.

webhookWinchBin.description: Winch binary for self-registration (default: WINCH_BIN env or `winch` on PATH).

dispatchEnabled.description: Wake agents from winch events (assignments, appended work, epic reviews). Default true.

dispatchWsUrl.description: Event stream to follow, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:38291 (default: that).

dispatchPlanner.description: Fallback planner for rows without a recorded creator (default: atlas).

dispatchStatePath.description: File remembering reviewed epics across restarts (default: ~/.openclaw/state/winch-plugin-dispatch.json).
